verdict.rationale: Pipedrive publishes a browsable first-party API reference at developers.pipedrive.com, with per-endpoint pages for Deals, Leads, Persons, Organizations and Webhooks, plus listed token costs. It also offers OpenAPI 3 specs for v1 and v2 and a developer sandbox account for risk-free testing. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples; importing the spec into another tool is a user-side workaround that earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented in-browser runnable or 'try it' requests in the reference, interactive code samples, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference experience.
